decisions.title: REORDERED PRODUCT CATALOG
decisions.reason: Ten approved Terac respondents rated every live product. USB-C Cable had the highest average purchase likelihood at 3.9/5; Laptop Cooling Pad followed at 3.8/5 and had the most most-likely selections (3). The ordering follows average rating, then the documented deterministic tie-breakers. The panel is directional and not statistically significant.
decisions.action: Moved USB-C Fast Charging Cable from position 2 to 1, Magnetic Phone Mount from 9 to 3, Wireless Earbuds from 7 to 4, and reordered all remaining products by the approved-response ranking without changing prices or checkout links.
